description: Pruning of a Eucalyptus tree in the rear garden subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/117/2/85 by reducing crown height to previous reduction points, reducing branch proximity to property and neighbouring gardens, and cutting back ivy growth by 2m from previous reduction points.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to prune the Eucalyptus tree, subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/117/2/85, shall comprise only the following and must be carried out in accordance with British Standard BS3998:2010:

- Reduction of the crown height to the previous reduction points;
- Reduction of branch proximity to application property and neighbouring gardens, by pruning back to the previous reduction points; and
- Removal of ivy growth from the tree by cutting back the ivy to a distance of 2m from previous reduction points.

To ensure that the works are appropriately controlled and carried out in a manner that safeguards the health, appearance and amenity value of the protected tree, in accordance with Policies DC8 and OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 2 - No less than five working days' notice shall be given to the Council's Aboricultural Officer before any work commences to the tree (Telephone 020 8748 3020). 

In order that the Council has the opportunity to ensure that the work is carried out in accordance with Condition 1, in accordance with Policies DC8 and OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).
